eventDetail.scope: The scope of the International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA 2027) addresses a multi-tiered technological spectrum bridging fundamental engineering with next-generation innovations. At its core, the conference spans foundational disciplines in computer science, wireless communications, control theory, and industrial automation. Within these fields, it highlights operational subsets driving digital transformation, including edge-based Internet of Things (IoT) architectures, intelligent robotics, cyber-physical systems, VLSI design, smart grid energy management, and AI-driven cybersecurity. Pushing into frontier paradigms, ICCUBEA 2027 emphasizes emerging research avenues such as Agentic and Explainable AI (XAI), quantum computing algorithms, 6G communication networks, neuromorphic hardware acceleration, sustainable green IT, and climate-resilient intelligent infrastructure to solve complex industrial and societal challenges.
